The contract will be valid for a period of 6 month from the date of award of the contract. Rates approved shall be firm and fixed for a period of 6 month and no variation in rates shall be acce pted during the contract period. 7. lit bidding with proposed following conditions: I. Maximum number of bidders are 2 amongst which order may be split. II. If other bidders are not agreeing to match with L1 price fo r the award of 30% of quantity, then the whole quantity will be allotted to L1. 12. Payment Terms: I. Payment shall be released after completion of all formalities. No interest shall be payable by NUPPL on any delayed/ disputed payments. VI. Payments made by NUPPL shall not preclude the right of NUPPL to thereafter dispute any item i nvoiced. OTHER CONDITIONS:- 1.
